paragraphs.text: Marwyn is an elf druid from Kelfae in Llanowar , on Dominaria .

Marwyn is a diplomat and the most respected midwife of the Kelfae elves. She is also a stern diplomat who mediates disputes between rival elf factions with patience and guile. In her role as a leader, she takes pride in welcoming each new citizen in her domain.

Marwyn famously negotiated a treaty with an angry group of elves from another elfhame while at the bedside of a mother going through a difficult birth. In the end, Marwyn handed the newborn child to the opposing leader and ordered him to keep the child warm while she tended to the mother.

In the Echoverse created by the Theorist , Marwyn was the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae, adept at taking down the mighty trees of Llanowar singlehandedly. The elves of Llanowar were forced to harvest the trees to survive against the encroaching forces of Benalia after the Second Brothers' War. Though she was pained by the work she had to do, she saw it as a necessity for the survival of her people in their fight against Benalia.
